args.title: Bellwether Office Newsletter Summary – Cold-chain Logistics 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter topic: "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," highlighting the shift toward carriers sharing live sensor data across the supply chain.
- Main article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilot programs applying this live-data-sharing approach cut claims by a quarter, reinforcing the main article's findings on reduced rejected loads.
